heading: Emergency
description: Register arrivals in seconds, triage them and watch who is waiting.
empty: Nobody is in the emergency department.

register.title: Register an arrival
register.description: Only the complaint is needed. An unidentified patient gets a temporary ID at once.
register.choosePatient: Choose the patient, or register them as unidentified.
register.ageHint: In years, if it can be guessed.
register.aliasHint: For example, man in a blue jacket.

triage.title: Set the triage category
triage.description: For {{id}}. The waiting target follows the category.

identify.title: Identify the patient
identify.description: Link {{id}} to the patient's record. The temporary ID stays on the case.

done.identified: {{id}} is linked to the patient's record.

errors.patient: That patient is not available to you.
errors.identified: This case already has a patient.
errors.changed: Someone else changed this first. The board has been refreshed; try again.
errors.left: This patient has already left the department.
errors.identifyFirst: Link the patient to a record first.
errors.drafts: A note on the patient’s record is still a draft. Sign or discard it first.
errors.destination: Say where the patient is referred to.
errors.deathFuture: The time of death cannot be in the future.
errors.permission: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.module: That part of the hospital system is switched off.
errors.doctor: There is no doctor to admit under. Ask a doctor to do this, or choose one.
errors.policeStation: Name the police station that was informed.

orders.heading: Rapid orders
orders.notOpen: Choose “Prepare orders” to place lab, imaging and procedure orders for this patient.
orders.needsPatient: Link the patient to a record to place orders. Notes can be written meanwhile.

disposition.title: How the patient leaves
disposition.needsPatient: Link the patient to a record before admitting.
disposition.doctorHint: Leave empty to admit under your own profile.

mlc.heading: Medico-legal record
mlc.notFlagged: This case is not marked medico-legal.
mlc.restricted: This case is medico-legal. The details are restricted to those with access to them.
mlc.narrativeHint: What was found and what was said about how it happened.
mlc.revised: The medico-legal record of {{id}} was revised.
mlc.history: Every revision is kept; nothing is overwritten. Every view of this record is logged.
